_about: The reviewed registry of every instrument the Flock may hold, keyed by ticker. scripts/check.py takes type, issuer, sector, bucket and the leverage flags from HERE, never from labels in holdings.json or sleeves.json. A ticker that is not listed cannot be held. Adding or changing a row needs a maintainer's review: market_cap_usd_min is a conservative lower bound (stocks only), gold must be true exactly when sector is gold, and leveraged or inverse funds are banned outright. Facts are public fund and company descriptions; not investment advice.

VTI.name: Vanguard Total Stock Market ETF
VTI.notes: Tracks the whole US stock market. The core: it always gets what the other pieces leave.

SGOV.name: iShares 0-3 Month Treasury Bond ETF
SGOV.notes: Holds US Treasury bills maturing in under three months. The waiting-cash (regime) instrument.

SMH.name: VanEck Semiconductor ETF
SMH.notes: Large US-listed semiconductor companies. Concentrated in a handful of names.

GOOGL.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A
GOOGL.notes: Common stock of Alphabet Inc. Any other Alphabet share class must use the same issuer so the per-company cap covers both.

IAU.name: iShares Gold Trust
IAU.notes: Trust holding physical gold bullion. Counts toward the gold cap.

XLV.name: Health Care Select Sector SPDR Fund
XLV.notes: The health care companies of the S&P 500.

BOTZ.name: Global X Robotics & Artificial Intelligence ETF
BOTZ.notes: Global companies in robotics, automation and artificial intelligence.

IBIT.name: iShares Bitcoin Trust ETF
IBIT.notes: Spot bitcoin trust: holds bitcoin, no leverage.
